title: GeneralContact: the implicit solver keeps a contact only while its force presses, the explicit one while the bodies penetrate
author: Claude-JG
description: With contact damping, the active set of the implicit solver (PostNewton) takes a contact only if k*gap + d*v_n < 0; the explicit solver, and ObjectContactSphereSphere / SphereTriangle / Coordinate in both, take it while gap < 0, so the damping can pull at the end of a contact. A ball dropped onto a triangle rebounds to 0.1391 implicit against 0.1352 (contactComparisonTest.py). Decision: which of the two is the model, and then make both solvers do it.
